planAnalysis.PamReason: PAM = sum(MU-weight * blocked target BEV area / total target BEV area) / sum(MU-weight). DOI:10.1002/mp.70144. Endpoint trapezoidal sampling; no clinical threshold.
planAnalysis.GeometryProvenance: Illustrative synthetic apertures and perspective projection of the same PTV_60 ellipsoid, not a commissioned machine model. The analytical phantom dose is not dose calculated from apertures. All control points; each endpoint receives half the MU of each adjacent interval. Geometry in isocenter-plane mm; areas in cm2. Small-aperture fraction is the MU-weighted proportion of endpoint apertures below the stated area, not a clinical limit.
planAnalysis.DoseRateProvenance: Estimated synthetic plan trace; calculated from cumulative MU, gantry angles and explicit synthetic speed limits. No measured delivery.

Beams.DoseRateEstimateReason: PlanCheck-style ESTIMATE from normalized cumulative MU, gantry angles, configured speed and nominal MU/min; not time-resolved ESAPI or measured delivery. Ignores acceleration, MLC/jaw dynamics, dose ramping and holds. Configured assumption: Public synthetic example only. Configured gantry-speed bound; excludes acceleration, leaf motion and holds.

planAnalysis.TargetQualityNote: Paddick CI = TV_Rx² / (TV × V_Rx); 1 / Paddick CI = (TV × V_Rx) / TV_Rx². GI = V_50%Rx / V_Rx in the existing EXTERNAL (whole plan, not lesion-specific). HI (PlanCheck) = (D2% - D98%) / Rx, not the D50-normalized variant. Rx is the displayed plan prescription, not an inferred SIB target dose. Values are descriptive, not approval criteria. Volume sampling: 3 mm isotropic voxel centers; cumulative DVH bins: 0.1 Gy. Analytical phantom dose is not dose calculated from apertures; this is a software demonstration, not physical dosimetric validation.
